description: This file contains platform-specific socket operations and network utilities for BSD-like systems, including socket creation, binding, connection, and message handling, with special handling for macOS and Windows platforms.

classes.name: us_internal_udp_packet_buffer
classes.description: Internal structure for UDP packet buffer, with platform-specific fields for handling multiple messages and socket addresses.

methods.name: bsd_sendmmsg
methods.description: Emulates sendmmsg on platforms that lack it, with platform-specific implementations for macOS, Windows, and others.

methods.name: bsd_recvmmsg
methods.description: Emulates recvmmsg on platforms that lack it, with platform-specific implementations for macOS, Windows, and others.

methods.name: bsd_udp_packet_buffer_local_ip
methods.description: Retrieves the local IP address from a UDP packet buffer, platform-specific.

methods.name: bsd_udp_packet_buffer_peer
methods.description: Retrieves the peer address from a UDP packet buffer.

methods.name: bsd_udp_packet_buffer_payload
methods.description: Accesses the payload data in a UDP packet buffer.

methods.name: bsd_udp_packet_buffer_payload_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the payload in a UDP packet buffer.

methods.name: bsd_udp_buffer_set_packet_payload
methods.description: Sets the payload and peer address in a UDP packet buffer.

methods.name: bsd_create_udp_packet_buffer
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a UDP packet buffer, platform-specific.

methods.name: apple_no_sigpipe
methods.description: Sets socket option to prevent SIGPIPE signals on macOS.

methods.name: bsd_set_nonblocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: bsd_socket_nodelay
methods.description: Enables or disables TCP_NODELAY on a socket.

methods.name: bsd_socket_flush
methods.description: Disables TCP_CORK (or equivalent) to flush socket buffers.

methods.name: bsd_create_socket
methods.description: Creates a socket with specified domain, type, and protocol, sets non-blocking and platform-specific options.

methods.name: bsd_close_socket
methods.description: Closes a socket.

methods.name: bsd_shutdown_socket
methods.description: Shuts down socket's send operations.

methods.name: bsd_shutdown_socket_read
methods.description: Shuts down socket's receive operations.

methods.name: internal_finalize_bsd_addr
methods.description: Parses and finalizes BSD socket address info into a usable form.

methods.name: bsd_local_addr
methods.description: Retrieves local address of a socket.

methods.name: bsd_remote_addr
methods.description: Retrieves remote peer address of a socket.

methods.name: bsd_addr_get_ip
methods.description: Returns the IP address from a BSD address structure.

methods.name: bsd_addr_get_ip_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the IP address.

methods.name: bsd_addr_get_port
methods.description: Returns the port number.

methods.name: bsd_accept_socket
methods.description: Accepts a new incoming socket connection, platform-specific.

methods.name: bsd_recv
methods.description: Receives data from a socket.

methods.name: bsd_write2
methods.description: Writes header and payload to a socket using writev or multiple send calls.

methods.name: bsd_send
methods.description: Sends data on a socket, with support for TCP_NODELAY and TCP_CORK.

methods.name: bsd_would_block
methods.description: Checks if the last socket operation would block.

methods.name: bsd_create_listen_socket
methods.description: Creates, binds, and listens on a TCP socket, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: bsd_create_listen_socket_unix
methods.description: Creates, binds, and listens on a UNIX domain socket.

methods.name: bsd_create_udp_socket
methods.description: Creates a UDP socket, supports IPv4 and IPv6, with socket options for packet info.

methods.name: bsd_create_connect_socket
methods.description: Creates and connects a TCP socket to a specified host and port, with optional source address.

methods.name: bsd_create_connect_socket_unix
methods.description: Creates and connects a UNIX domain socket to a server path.
